charts.title: K2-155 d: orbits around K2-155
charts.description: The orbits of K2-155's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-155 d highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Hirano et al. 2018 (2018AJ....155..124H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname HIRANO_ET_AL__2018): P 40.6835 d
